title: Not holding reliable connection to g6 on android 9. Readings every 15 min or not at all. Have to constantly restart collector manually.
symptom: The xDrip collector frequently fails to connect to the Dexcom G6 sensor, getting stuck on 'connecting' or 'scanning' status, requiring manual restart of the collector to get readings. Readings occur every 15 minutes or not at all.
evidence_quote: Status page just stays on either connecting or scanning. Seems it gets stuck there.
